test.result: Calendar tests pass within the focused market-data set; special-session, expiry, instrument-window, missing-window and invalid-window behavior are covered with synthetic fixtures.

implemented: Versioned explicit calendars accept holidays, special-session dates, expiry dates and per-instrument local open/close windows.
Special-session entries override a holiday/weekday closure; unknown instruments and missing windows fail closed for time-window checks.
Invalid timezone, reversed time range and duplicate instrument windows are rejected.
blockers: No official exchange calendar source is bundled or provenance-attested; current dates and holiday coverage require owner-supplied source records.
No historical golden dataset currently validates actual expiry schedules and known NSE/BSE special-session mechanics.
Instrument windows and expiry schedules are not automatically resolved from effective-dated instrument master rules into every runner.
scope_note: The software contract and synthetic mechanics tests exist; production calendar completeness and exchange-specific evidence remain external and unverified.
